application_feedback.semantics: Every displayed control mode freeze state capture span decision count history count voice count and diagnostic is read from the latest accepted Core snapshot rather than raw GUI input.
The UI draws only a fixed 256-sample decimated snapshot with accepted write position anchor field and active-head observations; it never reads or writes the live capture store.
JUCE presents selectable device configuration; no selected endpoint name receipt result or lifecycle claim is serialized into musical Core state.

endpoint_device_evidence.notes: The target may expose JUCE device settings when a user later launches it. Task 048 performs no app launch endpoint enumeration input receipt output playback MIDI mapping or reconnect test.

gesture_state_machines.semantics: A rising GUI action toggles accepted capture writes at the next block boundary; repeated action sequence numbers are ignored.
A rising action begins a 10 ms memory-body fade, invalidates capture and recurrence once zero is reached, then restores the eligible path; repeated action sequence numbers are idempotent.
Reset reconstructs defaults seed memory and diagnostics without reallocating; Panic preserves controls and capture but clears voices body scheduler and output history.
